chapter: Rhythm and blues, the Howard Theatre and later years
title: Years of gigging, then Ivory Joe Hunter and Tiny Bradshaw
summary: Phillips gigged around D.C. from 1946, toured with Ivory Joe Hunter in 1951 and Tiny Bradshaw in 1953, both strictly rhythm-and-blues.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows
